title: Reference pacing demo (real data from video-watch scene counts, 2026-11-28)

beats.say: I watched five reference videos, frame by frame.
beats.title: THE REFERENCES
beats.caption: transcripts, scenes, keyframes

beats.say: Then I counted how often each one cuts to a new shot.
beats.caption: shots per minute

beats.say: The fast design reel cuts fifteen times a minute. The launch video, thirteen.
beats.title: CUT RATE
beats.caption: fast reels cut constantly

beats.say: The explainers barely cut at all.
beats.caption: explainers stay on one canvas

beats.say: The trig reel holds one shot for almost the whole video.
beats.title: THE CALM ONE
beats.caption: one continuous canvas

beats.say: That is the style this engine copies. Build the picture once, then teach on top of it.
beats.caption: build once, teach on top
